title: It will rain today, you know.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It will rain today, you know.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But the sky is completely clear right now.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But I think I smelled the rain coming.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It smells like wet dirt, and I think it's close.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It will really pour, I think.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: We will see if you are right about it.

variations: "rain" 换 "get cold"；"smelled it" 换 "felt it"。
